methods.window: monthly midpoints, nearest 50 eligible bases, include distance ties; complete fixed battery BEFORE windows; 20–49 bases use whole panel; fewer than 20 static
methods.base_date: earliest eligible date within base; preserves all configurations together
methods.scaling: fixed complete dated source-panel mean and sample SD; selected-config sensitivities reuse parent scaling
methods.bootstrap: 2000 global whole-base multinomial draws per source, matched across its windows and variants; fixed eligibility/scaling/window membership; >=3 sampled distinct bases and unique PC1 required
methods.intervals: pointwise percentile, withheld below 90% admissible; no formal rotation null test or simultaneous coverage
methods.comparison: each series has its own first window, battery and source scale; overlay is descriptive, not equal latent units
methods.shared_battery: no verified multi-benchmark protocol-equivalent cross-source battery established; direct cross-source vector angles withheld
